mix_by_vortexing(mixture="lysate")

mix_by_vortexing(mixture="lysate")

centrifuge_column(column="DNeasy spin column", centrifuge_speed="8000 x g", centrifuge_time="1 min")
discard_tube_and_flow_through(collection_tube="flow-through")

pipet_mixture_to_column(mixture="Buffer AW1", column_type="DNeasy spin column", collection_tube_vol="2 mL")
centrifuge_column(column="DNeasy spin column", centrifuge_speed="8000 x g", centrifuge_time="1 min")
discard_tube_and_flow_through(collection_tube="flow-through")

# 9. Wash with Buffer AW2

pipet_mixture_to_column(mixture="Buffer AW2", column_type="DNeasy spin column", collection_tube_vol="2 mL")
centrifuge_column(column="DNeasy spin column", centrifuge_speed="8000 x g", centrifuge_time="1 min")
discard_tube_and_flow_through(collection_tube="flow-through")

# 10. Dry spin column

# 11. Elute DNA

elute_DNA(column="DNeasy spin column", volume="100 µL", buffer="Buffer AE")
